status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 33% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Baghdad has closed the Sheeb border crossing with Iran amid US pressure, while Iranian officials deny Iraqi claims of expelling Kurdish opposition from the area. Israeli fighter jets conducted drills in Iraqi airspace near the Iranian border, and US and Israel are reported to be preparing new strikes against Iran following the midterm elections. Logistics efforts are underway to resupply warships engaged in the Iran war, indicating broader regional military activity. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Bagdad har stengt Sheeb-grenseovergangen mot Iran etter press fra USA, mens iranske tjenestemenn benekter irakiske påstander om at de har utvist kurdisk opposisjon fra området. Israels jagerfly holdt øvelser i irakisk luftrom nær den iranske grensen, og USA og Israel skal forberede nye angrep mot Iran etter midtveisvalgene. Logistikkarbeid pågår for å forsyne krigsskip som er involvert i Iran-krigen, noe som tyder på bredere militær aktivitet i regionen. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
